property.name: dfs.replication
property.description: TPCx-HS Specification v2.0.3 clause 4.4 requires a replication factor of at least 3. A single-node cluster physically cannot satisfy that, so this run is NON-COMPLIANT by design and is for Milestone 2/3 coursework only.

property.name: dfs.blocksize
property.description: 128 MB. A 1 GB HSGen dataset therefore spans ~8 blocks.

property.name: dfs.datanode.du.reserved
property.description: Reserve 2 GB of the 30 GB volume so HDFS cannot fill the root fs.

property.name: dfs.namenode.secondary.http-address
property.description: Pinned to localhost on purpose. Left at the 0.0.0.0 default, sbin/start-dfs.sh rewrites it to $(hostname) ("jihopc") and then tries to ssh there, which fails because only localhost/127.0.0.1 are authorised.
